name: Analyst Never Sleep
description:
Your personal analyst. Always on. Never sleeps.   
                            
Built for fundamental investors who want an edge with hours of researched prepared when you wake up, in your own way.
                                                                                
 What it does for you:                                                         
   
  - Never miss a market move — wake up to a structured daily briefing covering macro shifts, sector moves, and news on your watchlist
  - Cut research time in half — run a full company deep dive in seconds, not hours. Financials, thesis, risks, all in one shot                             
  - Walk into earnings ready — get a pre-earnings framework before the call and a post-earnings breakdown after                                               
  - Think in memos, not notes — turn your thesis into a clean, shareable investment memo with one command                                              
  - Track what matters — manage your watchlist in plain English. Levels, catalysts, conviction — all in one place                                      
                  
  Who it's for:                                                                 
  Retail investors, self-directed traders, and finance students who think like analysts but don't have a research team behind them.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**.

- **Skills** (5): `company-deep-dive` (Conduct a comprehensive investment research deep dive on a public company or asset), `daily-market-briefing` (Generate a structured daily market briefing for equity and macro investment analysts), `earnings-prep` (Prepare for an upcoming earnings event or analyze a just-released earnings report), `investment-memo` (Write a formal investment memo or one-pager for a position or trade idea), `watchlist-manager` (Manage the AnalystNeverSleep watchlist via natural language)

Installs with `claude plugin install analyst-never-sleep@claude-community` from `kmmz/analyst_never_sleep` (`investment-analyst`).
